Meena (Support): Escalating to CS — NimbusRx trial blocked: customer reports 403s during SSO provisioning and failed webhooks after a large import. Ticket #22401 attached logs. Renewal check: trial ends in ~26 days, they're doing a 2-week pilot.
Ravi (CS): Thanks Meena. Quick context: tier and any committed spend?
Meena (Support): Trial - pilot only, no ARR yet. Error snippet from API: `{"error":"access_denied","status":403,"detail":"quota_or_key_issue"}`. They ran a 500k-row dataset ingest.
Diego (SE): This smells like combined quota + temporary key throttle. Two parts: (1) provisioning flow times out if webhook callbacks are delayed; (2) large embed batches can trip throttle. Immediate mitigation: apply a short emergency quota raise (24-72h) and enable smaller batch retry at client side.
Ravi (CS): Comms plan suggestion: 1) Immediate outreach acknowledging impact + what we did, 2) Offer 48h quota adjustment and suggested client workaround, 3) Schedule 30m troubleshooting with SE + support, 4) Capture onboarding UX issues and add to docs. Who owns outreach?
Elena (CS Manager): I will own the outreach and customer call. @Claire please add commercial context in the email. Ravi, can you draft the customer message and paste here for quick review?
Claire (AE): Add a sentence about prioritizing their pilot completion and that we1re treating it as high-priority to not jeopardize renewal. Keep tone concise and reassuring.
Meena (Support): Ticket update: \"Escalated to CS. Applied +1200 quota units for 48h as temporary mitigation. POC: Elena.\" Putting curl they used for repro: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/provision -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' -d '{"tenant":"nimbusrx"}'`
Diego (SE): I1ll collect full request/response traces and check timing against key rotations. If webhook callbacks are delayed >10s, that explains provisioning failures.
Ravi (CS): Draft email (will post in 8m): Subject: \"Redwood — immediate SSO/provisioning update for NimbusRx\". Body will include steps taken, link to temporary workaround doc, and proposed call times.
Elena (CS Manager): Scheduling call: 2024-05-12 11:00 PST (30m). Invite includes NimbusRx, SE, Support. Action items: (A) Elena: send email & own outreach, (B) Diego: confirm quota bump + collect traces, (C) Nate/Docs: add a short runbook bullet on onboarding large ingest flows, (D) CS: set renewal watch flag in CRM.
Nate (Docs): I1ll draft a short onboarding note (1-2 bullets) about safe ingest batch sizes and SSO callback timing by EOD tomorrow.
Ravi (CS): After the call we1ll create a 48h follow-up and a short playbook entry so CS/Support follow the same mitigation path for similar pilots. Will tag retention risk in CRM and schedule a check-in 7 days post-unblock.
Meena (Support): Final ticket note for now: \"Customer tentatively unblocked after quota bump. Awaiting scheduled call and SE trace confirmation. If still failing, escalate to eng oncall.\"
Elena (CS Manager): Thanks everyone — please watch for my email draft and quick review. We1ll produce a 48h postmortem and remediation list if this is recurring. :thumbsup:
-- end thread --
